fact: The Ministry of ICT's newsletter of 29 October 2025 reports a monitoring dashboard for the Digital Transformation Blueprint 2025-2029, recording each project with its scope, phases, milestones and KPIs, and presented to the Inter-ministerial Committee chaired by the Minister on 26 August and 2 October 2025.
title: Ministry of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation: Newsletter, Issue no. 2
publisher: Ministry of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation, Mauritius
